issues.concern: The gloss 'feeling chilly' is too narrow and potentially misleading. 'ひやひや' can describe a cool sensation without necessarily implying 'chilly' (which often has a negative connotation of being uncomfortably cold). It can also describe a refreshing coolness.

The English translation 'The sweat cools and dries on my skin' adds 'on my skin' which is not present in the Japanese and changes the nuance. The Japanese focuses on the sweat itself cooling and drying.
